# Historical FlashKDA bridge attribution

The source-built comparison bridge has been removed. This directory retains
its [source inventory and credits](provenance.json), MoonshotAI MIT license and
SparkGLM license. The inventory records original file hashes, upstream paths,
and the Atlas revision from which removed files can be recovered.

Current native KDA uses the [credited device subset](../../crates/spark-runtime/cuda/glm_kda/vendor/provenance.json)
through Atlas's own compiled operator. These historical recipes are not build
or runtime dependencies.
